points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 希罗多德出生于古希腊的哈利卡尔那索斯，他的家庭是当地的一个富裕家庭。他在这里接受了良好的教育，包括历史、文学和哲学。他的父亲是一位商人，这使希罗多德有机会旅行并接触到不同的文化和观点。
points.descriptionEn: Herodotus was born in Halicarnassus, Greece, into a wealthy family. He received a good education in history, literature, and philosophy here. His father was a merchant, which allowed Herodotus to travel and be exposed to different cultures and viewpoints.

points.title: 埃及之旅
points.description: 希罗多德在公元前445年左右前往埃及，这是他著名的旅行之一。他在埃及研究了尼罗河的灌溉系统，并收集了关于埃及历史和文化的资料。这次旅行对他的历史写作产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Around 445 BC, Herodotus traveled to Egypt, one of his famous journeys. He studied the Nile's irrigation system in Egypt and collected information about Egyptian history and culture. This journey had a profound impact on his historical writing.

points.title: 波斯之旅
points.description: 希罗多德在公元前440年前往波斯，这是为了了解波斯帝国的政治和社会结构。他在波斯期间，收集了关于波斯与希腊之间冲突的详细信息，这些信息后来成为了他的著作《历史》的基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 440 BC, Herodotus traveled to Persia to understand the political and social structure of the Persian Empire. During his time in Persia, he collected detailed information about the conflict between Persia and Greece, which later became the basis for his work 'The Histories'.

points.title: 雅典的写作
points.description: 希罗多德在雅典完成了他的杰作《历史》。这部作品详细记录了希腊与波斯之间的战争，以及希罗多德所了解的其他文明。这部著作对后世的历史学产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Herodotus completed his masterpiece 'The Histories' in Athens. This work detailed the Greco-Persian Wars and other civilizations as he understood them. This work had a profound impact on historical writing for posterity.

appraisal.zh: 希罗多德被公认为西方历史写作的奠基者，《历史》为后世保存了珍贵资料，其广博见闻与批判意识长期受到肯定。也有研究者指出，他的记述带有主观与夸大的成分，书中夹杂大量神话传说，与现代史学方法存在距离。尽管如此，他作为史学先驱的地位及其对后世研究的深远影响，仍是学界的基本判断。
appraisal.en: Herodotus is widely acknowledged as the founder of Western historical writing; The Histories preserved valuable material for later ages, and his wide inquiry and critical awareness have long been recognized. Some researchers point out, however, that his account carries subjective and exaggerated elements and includes much myth and legend, falling short of modern historical method. Even so, his standing as a pioneer of history and his profound influence on later scholarship remain the standard view.

supporter.zh: 希罗多德被誉为‘历史之父’，他的《历史》是西方历史学的奠基之作。他以其详实的记录和批判性思维而受到赞誉，为后世提供了宝贵的历史资料。
supporter.en: Herodotus is hailed as the 'Father of History,' and his 'The Histories' is considered the foundation of Western historical writing. He is praised for his detailed records and critical thinking, providing valuable historical materials for posterity.

critic.zh: 一些学者批评希罗多德的历史记录存在主观性和夸大其词的情况。他的作品也受到批评，因为它包含了大量的神话和传说，而不是纯粹的历史事实。
critic.en: Some scholars criticize Herodotus for the subjectivity and exaggeration in his historical records. His work is also criticized for containing a large amount of mythology and legend rather than purely historical facts.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，希罗多德被视为历史学的先驱，他的作品对后世的历史研究产生了深远的影响。然而，他也受到批评，因为他的历史方法与现代历史学的要求有所不同。
objective.en: In the field of history, Herodotus is considered a pioneer of historical writing, and his work has had a profound impact on historical research. However, he is also criticized for not meeting the standards of modern historical methodology.

self.en: History is the witness of time.
